content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for DHFWO Koppal recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for DHFWO Koppal recruitment is scheduled for 07 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in the DHFWO Koppal recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Junior Laboratory Technical Officer, Pharmacist Officer, and Nursing Officer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced by DHFWO Koppal?
faq.answer: A total of 26 vacancies have been announced for the Junior Laboratory Technical Officer, Pharmacist Officer, and Nursing Officer posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Laboratory Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Laboratory Technology from Karnataka Government recognized institutions only.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the posts announced by DHFWO Koppal?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DHFWO Koppal recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the DHFWO Koppal located?
faq.answer: The District Health and Family Welfare Office Koppal is located in Koppal, Karnataka, with a pincode of 583231.
